sentences.text: Over five weeks the copilot processed all forty SBA files.
Field-level accuracy was 96.8 percent against Jen's hand-checked set, and every field had a page citation.
The citations are what made the review fast. My team checked a file in about forty minutes.
That is the number I needed. I want to try commercial real estate next.
Decision: extend the Underwriting Copilot pilot to commercial real estate files in November.
We'll need rent rolls and operating statements. Different layout, so expect a week of tuning.
